text.tspan: SQSO-HW-DIAG-001 · source circuits on the EPS and RF boards; OBC series R and reservoir C from SQSO-OBC-BRD-001 · firmware scale = adc.rs FRONT_END
EPS: INA186 x 50 on RS6, REF 1.65 V
x 6.0, on above 1.0 V (new, RID AV-06)
x 6.0, on above 1.0 V (new, RID AV-06)
JET: spreader NTC RT1 via J3-5, 10.0k 0.1 % from VDDA
R = 10.0k V/(VDDA - V); 100 nF at the pin (new, E10)
Series resistors: 1 kOhm on the EPS lines (their sources are >= 167 kOhm with 100 nF), 10 kOhm on the RF lines (the radio
stays powered while the OBC is power-cycled: they limit the current into an unpowered OBC). The source's capacitor is the
reservoir for the 247.5-cycle sample. Sun sensors, the sensor-area temperature and VBAT_MTQ / 6 are on the ADS7138 (S6).
ADC1 IN8 (PA3) is the RF_TX_EN output; internal channels: temperature, VREFINT. Version 3: IN7 (PA2) reads the spreader NTC.
